Important information

Safety Information

Contains Milk and Soy

Ingredients

Protein Blend (Whey Protein Isolate, Whey Protein Concentrate, Hydrolyzed Whey Protein), Sunflower and/or Soy Lecithin, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Citric Acid, Sucralose, Red 40 Lake. CONTAINS: MILK AND SOY.

Directions

Mix about one scoop of the powder into 6 to 8 fluid ounces of cold water, milk or other beverage. Stir, shake or blend until dissolved. For best results, mix up your shake 30 to 60 minutes after your workout or use as an anytime snack in your balanced diet. For healthy adults, consume enough protein to meet your daily protein requirements with a combination of high protein foods and protein supplements throughout the day as part of a balanced diet and exercise program.

Product Description

Product Description

OPTIMUM NUTRITION'S GOLD STANDARD 100% Whey uses pure Whey Protein Isolates as the primary ingredient. Combined with ultra-filtered whey protein concentrate, each serving provides 24 grams of all-whey protein and 5.5 grams of naturally occurring Branched Chain Amino Acids (BCAAs) which are prized by athletes for their muscle building qualities. With more than 20 tempting flavors to choose from, ON GOLD STANDARD 100% Whey gives you plenty of ways to keep workout recovery interesting. Search "ON Apparel TRUE STRENGTH" to see our new ON clothing line!

    I recently purchased the Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 100% Whey Protein Powder in Delicious Strawberry flavor, and I'm thrilled with my purchase. As someone who is committed to maintaining an active and healthy lifestyle, I'm always on the lookout for high-quality protein supplements to support my fitness goals.

    This protein powder is an excellent choice for anyone looking to supplement their diet with high-quality protein. The powder mixes easily with water or milk, and the Delicious Strawberry flavor is absolutely delicious. I look forward to my post-workout shake every day!

    What I appreciate most about this protein powder is its high quality. It's made from whey protein isolates, which are some of the purest and most bioavailable forms of protein available. This ensures that my body can quickly and efficiently absorb the nutrients it needs to repair and build muscle tissue.

    The 10-pound bag is also a great value, and it will last me for months of regular use. Additionally, the packaging is well-designed and makes it easy to measure out the perfect serving size.

    Overall, I'm very happy with my purchase of the Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 100% Whey Protein Powder. It's a high-quality product that delivers on taste, quality, and value. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for an effective and delicious way to support their fitness goals.

    I've been using ON Gold 100% Whey protein for over a decade now... price has stayed relatively stable. I ration mine a bit because this isn't a cheap product, but it's still one of the top 3 post-workout whey protein powders out there. And tastes great, especially when used to make a post-workout smoothie with my special recipe (provided below 100% free to you):

    + 1.5 or 2 scoops of Optimum Nutrition 100% Whey Protein powder

    + 2 cups Lactose-free Milk

    + 1 ripe banana

    + 5 teardrops of gym weaklings

    - Put the milk and peeled banana into a blender

    - Blend normally till smooth

    - Add protein powder

    - Add the 5 teardrops (or substitute with a dash of Cinnamon powder, that's fine too)

    - Blend gently till all smooth

    Enjoy!

  • W. Burn
    4 out of 5 stars
    High Quality Whey and a lot of it.
    Reviewed in the United States on June 17, 2013
    Flavor Name: StrawberrySize: 10 Pound (Pack of 1)
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I have done a lot of research comparing many different key factors on whey protein and various other weight gainers for supplementation and have tried many. Calculating quality factors taken into consideration include mixing quality, flavor options, taste, sugar, carbohydrate, sodium, protein & protein per serving %(PPS), fat levels, and finally cost all demonstrate the quality of this product.

    Considering all the above factors EXCEPT COST, I have found 2 products I consider marginally better primarily based on protein percentage (ISO 100[84% PPS] & Hydrobolic FX [90% PPS]). I have tried both of these products and can attest to there effectiveness. That being said; both of these other products are over $40 more per 10 lbs (a cost difference which can't be justified). Also note: Hydrobolic FX flavors are limited and both poor in my opinion so although it has the best features it is tough to swallow, ISO 100 smooth banana is fairly tasty.

    Gold Standard excels: both sugar and carbohydrates are just about non-existent, I have never had a product dissolve better yet, and the flavor choices are awesome; mocha cappuccino is hands down the best and most versatile being able to mix it with coffee; milk, & water. Looking at the nutritional facts of this item you will note the PPS is high while sugar and carbohydrates are practically non-existing.

    This review is specifically for the 10lb strawberry which is also very tasty, but not as versatile as other flavors.

About this Item

  • Gold Standard 100% Whey - 24g of protein per serving to help build and maintain muscle when taken over time with regular resistance training
  • 5.5g of aturally occurring branched chain amino acids (BCAAs) to support muscle recovery
  • Anytime formula – great before or after exercise, between meals, with a meal, or any time of day when you need extra protein
  • Banned substance tested and the highest quality control measures so you feel comfortable and confident consuming the product
  • Optimum Nutrition is the World's #1 Sports Nutrition Brand*

Product Description

Product Description

OPTIMUM NUTRITION'S GOLD STANDARD 100% Whey uses pure Whey Protein Isolates as the primary ingredient. Combined with ultra-filtered whey protein concentrate, each serving provides 24 grams of all-whey protein and 5.5 grams of naturally occurring Branched Chain Amino Acids (BCAAs) which are prized by athletes for their muscle building qualities. With more than 20 tempting flavors to choose from, ON GOLD STANDARD 100% Whey gives you plenty of ways to keep workout recovery interesting. Search "ON Apparel TRUE STRENGTH" to see our new ON clothing line!

Important Information

Safety Information

Contains Milk and Soy

Ingredients

Protein Blend (Whey Protein Isolate, Whey Protein Concentrate, Hydrolyzed Whey Protein), Sunflower and/or Soy Lecithin, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Citric Acid, Sucralose, Red 40 Lake. CONTAINS: MILK AND SOY.

Directions

Mix about one scoop of the powder into 6 to 8 fluid ounces of cold water, milk or other beverage. Stir, shake or blend until dissolved. For best results, mix up your shake 30 to 60 minutes after your workout or use as an anytime snack in your balanced diet. For healthy adults, consume enough protein to meet your daily protein requirements with a combination of high protein foods and protein supplements throughout the day as part of a balanced diet and exercise program.
